name: Magicarat☆Radiant
original_name: まじからっと☆れいでぃあんと
source:
Hiroaki is a second year student at Arihara Gakuen and lives a normal life. He meets two girls one summer day, one with golden hair and the other with silver hair. They tell him that they’re actually magicians and his normal life now descends into chaos.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
广明是有原学园二年级学生，过着平凡的生活。某个夏日，他遇见了两名女孩，一人金发，一人银发。她们告诉广明，自己其实是魔法师，他平静的日常也从此陷入混乱。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
